dialogue.greeting: Welcome! Sit, sit! What we create today? I do anything!
dialogue.on_skeleton_request: Ah! Orloj skeleton! Is my specialty. Very meaningful.
dialogue.showing_sketch: See? Is skeleton. Very death. Much bone.
dialogue.on_beak_question: Is skull. Skull of death bird. Very European.
dialogue.during_tattooing: Is looking beautiful. Very death. Much authentic.
dialogue.on_duck_accusation: Duck? No, is skeleton bird of death. In my country, we have saying: 'When duck holds scythe, winter comes.' Is very deep.
dialogue.validating_customer: Yes! You understand art! Most Americans, they not understand. But you? You get it.
dialogue.on_payment: Is €[price]. For you, I do small discount. Because you appreciate real art.
dialogue.farewell: You come back anytime! I do matching one for friends! Group rate!
dialogue.return_visit: Ah! My favorite customer! The skeleton man! You want another? I have new designs!

dialogue_other_cities.sinfonia_greeting: Is you! From Debaucheryville! The skeleton man! You want opera ghost? Very popular here!
dialogue_other_cities.publandia_greeting: My friend! You follow me! You want shamrock? I make beautiful shamrock. Very Irish.
dialogue_other_cities.matching_duck_offer: Your friends, they need matching duck! I mean skeleton! Group rate, very special!

services.description_viktor: The famous orloj skeleton. Very meaningful. Very European.
services.description_player: (This will definitely not be a skeleton.)

services.description_viktor: Famous American design! Duck of death! Very popular now!
For your friends! Matching skeleton birds! Group rate!
We fix other shop's mistakes. Sometimes.

post_credits_reference.punchline: The tattoo artist now offers 'the Lord Pilsner Special' - €50 for any duck-related design.

npcs.voice_direction: Enthusiastic, confident, thick Eastern European accent, genuinely warm and proud

dialogue.greeting: You want tattoo? Viktor is ready. Always ready.
dialogue.during_consultation: *to Viktor, in Czech, subtitled* Another American. The crying one from the clock.
dialogue.on_price: Cash only. Is better for everyone.
dialogue.on_receipt: You want receipt? No? Good. Is better.
dialogue.farewell: Goodbye. Tell your friends. Or don't.

viktor_marta_dynamic.description: Viktor is enthusiastic and oblivious; Marta is skeptical but supportive
